intent: A share you can see: the compare blocks put South Africa's 16,000 against India's 4,000, a split sets the 2 African species side by side, and the park with the most rhinos on Earth rises off the map.
pacing_profile: question read verbatim, three options, 3-s beat, reveal with the number, story beats shaped per episode (brief.md), punchline + short follow
pause_policy: Pause only at the marked ellipses; the beat is real silence (ticks come from quizscore.py).
title: Which country has the MOST wild rhinos?

lines.direction: the question, cold — curiosity comes from the map moving under it
lines.text: Which country has the most wild rhinos?

lines.direction: quick, each option its own beat

lines.text: South Africa. Around 6 in 10 wild rhinos live here.

lines.direction: ease back over the whole country; the Kenyan flag-ball thinks on 'Kenya' with a rhino sticker; the compare blocks stack 16,000 over 4,000 and 2,000 on 'India' with a horn sticker; a grass sticker on 'Africa' as the country pulses
lines.text: Kenya has around 2,000. India has around 4,000, nearly all with a single horn. South Africa has around 16,000.

lines.direction: drift east; the split slides in on 'species' — white rhino ≈ 17,500 left against black rhino ≈ 6,400 left, both labelled AFRICA; a white circle sticker on 'white'; a black circle sticker on 'black' as the country pulses
lines.text: There are 5 species. The 2 African ones live here, the white rhino, and the much rarer black rhino.

lines.direction: push in on the north-east; the Kruger outline lights and rises with a rhino sticker riding it on 'Kruger' as the pin and tag land, a tree sticker beside; the MOST RHINOS card on 'more'; the South African flag-ball grins on 'Earth' as the country pulses; pin leaves
lines.text: And the Kruger National Park holds more rhinos than any other place on Earth.

lines.direction: punchline, then a short follow — the outro visual asks
